test_title: PYST 7: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined segment in the following sentence.**

Raima takes her classes __very attentively.__
solution: The correct answer is: **Be all ears** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom "**Be all ears**" means to be eagerly and attentively listening or ready to hear what someone has to say. (उत्सुकतापूर्वक और ध्यानपूर्वक सुनना या किसी को क्या कहना है यह सुनने के लिए तैयार रहना) • **Example**: *When the professor mentioned a surprise announcement, the students were all ears, eagerly awaiting the news about the upcoming project.* • In the context of the sentence, if Raima is taking her classes very attentively, it suggests that she is fully engaged, focused, and eager to absorb the information being presented. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **In accordance with: **In agreement or conformity with a rule, guideline, or standard. (किसी नियम, दिशानिर्देश या मानक के साथ सहमति या अनुरूपता में) • **By blazing a trail: **To be a pioneer or a trendsetter by doing something innovative or groundbreaking. (कुछ नवोन्मेषी या अभूतपूर्व कार्य करके अग्रणी या ट्रेंडसेटर बनना) • **By losing in a cloud: **To be confused or to be uncomfortable. (भ्रमित होना या असहज होना) 3a:T641, The correct answer is: **Although the book was difficult to read, I persisted and eventually understood the complex ideas.**
